violations.text: The front service area is lacking a hand-washing sink. A hand washing sink must be installed at front service area. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026

Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (milk) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

Cakes, and protein balls packaged in the establishment were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Establishment date marked items during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair (prep unit, and back 1 door). Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026

The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dish machine. Establishment is to obtain test strips. New Violation. Correct By: 09/01/2026

The back prep area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Establishment is to install hand sink in back prep area. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2025
